title: 2026 UK PRTR method-code, threshold and reliability QA controls

sources.publisher: Department for Environment Food and Rural Affairs
sources.title: UK Pollutant Release and Transfer Register (PRTR) data sets
Reporting codes list: pollution inventory reporting

facts.source_fact: PRTR reporting distinguishes calculated, estimated, measured and unspecified reporting methods.
facts.expected_handling: Carry the method class with every reported value.

facts.source_fact: PRTR method code C_ETS identifies calculation using greenhouse-gas emissions trading monitoring and reporting guidance.
facts.expected_handling: Do not treat C_ETS values as direct measurements.

facts.source_fact: PRTR method code C_IPCC identifies calculation using IPCC Guidelines.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve IPCC method provenance.

facts.source_fact: PRTR method code C_EMEP identifies calculation using the UNECE/EMEP Emission Inventory Guidebook.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve guidebook-method provenance.

facts.source_fact: PRTR includes a calculation code for an accepted mass-balance method.
facts.expected_handling: Carry mass-balance status into derived confidence.

facts.source_fact: PRTR includes a code for a calculation methodology prescribed in a licence or operating permit.
facts.expected_handling: Bind permit-prescribed calculations to the relevant facility permit.

facts.source_fact: PRTR includes measurement methods based on internationally approved CEN or ISO standards.
facts.expected_handling: Do not collapse measured-standard data into generic measured status when method detail exists.

facts.source_fact: PRTR includes a code for measurement methodology prescribed by the competent authority in a permit.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve permit-specific method provenance.

facts.source_fact: PRTR includes a method code for measurement by weighing.
facts.expected_handling: Keep weighing-based data distinct from concentration measurements.

facts.source_fact: PRTR supports an estimated reporting category.
facts.expected_handling: Do not upgrade estimated values to measured or calculated.

facts.source_fact: PRTR supports an unspecified method code.
facts.expected_handling: Flag unspecified method provenance for downstream review.

facts.source_fact: PRTR industrial activities are represented with sector/activity codes.
facts.expected_handling: Attach activity-code scope before sector aggregation.

facts.source_fact: Pollution inventory reporting uses NOSE-P codes to describe source-emission processes.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve process-code provenance when available.

facts.source_fact: Reporting guidance uses NACE economic-activity codes.
facts.expected_handling: Do not equate NACE classification with pollutant method.

facts.source_fact: Reporting guidance includes waste codes used in pollution inventory submissions.
facts.expected_handling: Keep waste-code classification separate from pollutant identity.

facts.source_fact: Some PRTR site types report only when specified operating-capacity, output or size thresholds are exceeded.
facts.expected_handling: Apply the site-type threshold before interpreting absence.

facts.source_fact: A threshold shown as not applicable means no minimum reporting threshold applies for that site type.
facts.expected_handling: Do not invent a numeric threshold.

facts.source_fact: A pollutant can have different reporting thresholds for releases to air, water and land.
facts.expected_handling: Attach environmental medium to threshold tests.

facts.source_fact: Operators have legal responsibility for collecting and reporting required PRTR information.
facts.expected_handling: Keep operator responsibility distinct from regulator QA.

facts.source_fact: Defra describes PRTR quality assurance as an ongoing process under regular review.
facts.expected_handling: Version reliability assessments rather than treating them as permanent.

guard_patterns.handling: Preserve the cited source fact without broadening its scope.
Attach the applicable dataset, entity, geography or regulatory boundary before downstream use.
Attach reference period, release/update date and provisional/current/final status.
Carry source URL, publisher and calculation, reporting or quality-method provenance into derived outputs.
Do not convert aggregate, facility, industry or scheme-level evidence into parcel-level measured emissions without a separate parcel-binding gate.

generation_rule: CARTESIAN_PRODUCT facts x guard_patterns; control_id={package_id}_{fact_id}_{pattern_id}; each generated row inherits confidence_percent=99 and verification=PASS
